readme:
# AAA News Article Detail Returns the full text and basic metadata of one AAA news article about gasoline. It needs the article URL slug as input, such as `national-gas-average-drops-nearly-20-cents-in-one-week`. ## Use cases - Pull the full text of an AAA gas news release to quote or summarize it in a report. - Archive AAA news articles with their publish date and canonical link. - Show an article page in a fuel dashboard after a user picks a headline from a list. - Feed article text into a text analysis job that tracks how gas news is worded over time. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/aaa/news-article-detail" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"slug": "national-gas-average-drops-nearly-20-cents-in-one-week"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `slug` | string | Yes | Article URL slug (e.g. national-gas-average-drops-nearly-20-cents-in-one-week). Obtainable from get_news_articles results. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": { "content": "\n

WASHINGTON, DC (June 4, 2026) –&n…", "date": "2026-06-04T10:27:55", "id": 5086, "link": "https://gasprices.aaa.com/national-gas-average-drops-nearly-20-cents-in-one-week…", "slug": "national-gas-average-drops-nearly-20-cents-in-one-week", "title": "National Gas Average Drops Nearly 20 Cents in One Week" }, "status": "success" } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data.title` | Headline of the article. | | `data.content` | Article body as an HTML string. It contains tags such as `

` and HTML entities such as ` `, so parse or strip them before display. | | `data.date` | Publish date and time of the article in ISO 8601 form, without a time zone offset. | | `data.id` | Numeric ID of the article. | | `data.slug` | URL slug of the article. It matches the `slug` you sent. | | `data.link` | Full URL of the article on the AAA gas site. | | `status` | Request outcome. The value is `success` for a good call. | ## Notes - Get the `slug` from the results of [AAA News Articles](/apis/aaa/news-articles) or [AAA Search News Articles](/apis/aaa/search-news-articles). - The `slug` is the last path segment of `data.link`. - `data.content` is HTML, so render it as HTML or strip the tags for plain text. ## Pricing $0.01 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization.
